channel.title: Insurance Daily
channel.description: A ten-minute briefing on the US insurance market, every weekday morning. Rates and capacity, carrier appetite, claims and catastrophe losses, regulation, M&A and the insurtech deals that matter. Written for agents and brokers who need to know what moved before their first call of the day.

item.title: 24 September 2026 — Insurance Daily
item.description:
Thursday 24 September 2026. Today's US insurance briefing for agents and brokers.
- Hellman & Friedman Explores Sale of Applied Systems at Up to $10B, Sources Say (Insurance Journal) - Jane Kim's plan to remake California insurance draws fire as FAIR Plan increase nears (Insurance Business America) - Florida property insurers move from recovery to rate competition (Insurance Business America) - Florida's governor's race turns on a big question: who should carry the state's hurricane risk? (Insurance Business America) - Apollo’s Rowan Blasts Regulators for Handling of Walter Insurers (Claims Journal) - Northeast Expecting Torrential Rains, Flood Risk as Coastal Storm Builds (Insurance Journal) - New Meta smart glasses class action could test where privacy claims land (Insurance Business America) - Markets/Coverages: CFC Begins Affirmative AI for Intellectual Property; CRC Specialty Launches Insurisk Cyber (Insurance Journal)
Also: People Moves: Taylor Returns to Plymouth Rock Assurance as President and CEO; Fidelis hires Scor’s Williams as Pine Walk chief underwriting officer; DoorDash to Pay $131M for Underpaying NYC Delivery Workers
